source.attribution: NeqSim master, SystemPrEos with the matching AttractiveTerm* - the upstream this library is a port of, run from validation/neqsim/FlashTp.java
source.notes: The five-parameter Mathias-Copeman form, coefficients from the `umrcpa_mc1..5` columns, falling back to the base Soave form when every coefficient is unset.

derivation:
The driver was run for methane 0.6 / n-butane 0.4 at 330 K and 25 bar on SystemPrEos with `setAttractiveTerm(22)`. NeqSim printed:

  beta 0.8417175886604888
  k    [7.2194756704175935, 0.33777150909544695]
  x    [0.09623030507857866, 0.9037696949214213]
  y    [0.6947323462716603, 0.30526765372833975]
  Zl   0.09312109495085798
  Zv   0.8678701574483977

azoth reproduces all six to the same residue the other cubic cases show.
